hotels.title: Niseko Apartment-Style Suites with Daily Ski Shuttle, JPY10,000 Dining Credit & One Child Stays Free
hotels.description: Glide through some of the world’s finest powder with a stylish stay at this luxe Niseko retreat, perfectly positioned in the heart of Hirafu Village. Just moments from the Grand Hirafu ski lifts via complimentary shuttle, Chatrium Niseko places you within effortless reach of Hokkaido’s legendary slopes while offering a refined alpine base to return to each day. Framed by the snow-covered peaks of Mount Yotei and Mount Niseko-Annupuri, this contemporary escape blends convenience with comfort through spacious apartment-style suites ideal for both couples and families. Housed within the Shiki Niseko complex, the property is also home to an exceptional dining scene, including The Flats Restaurant & Bar for relaxed Hokkaido flavours, and Temporada for tasty tapas and premium wines. With ski equipment rental, private lockers and seamless transport to the lifts all at your fingertips, every detail is designed to maximise time on the mountain.
